_doc: EDOPS Signature Schema — updated 12 April 2026. Documents both the current API output (status: implemented) and planned extensions (status: planned). Example values are real API output for Timbuktu (16.766°N, -3.008°E), BasinATLAS Level 08, bands A–F, period 1350–1600 CE. _note and _status fields are documentation only and are stripped from API responses in future versions.
_design_note: Aspirational target: each field will carry {s: local_value, u: upstream_value} sub-objects with explicit null for uncomputed counterparts. Current API returns flat keys with '_upstream' suffix for u-values (e.g. aridity / aridity_upstream). The nested s/u structure is a planned schema revision, not current output.

_type_notes.containing_basin: single basin containing the query point via ST_Covers; smallest area when multiple match
_type_notes.buffer: planned: area-weighted mean over basins within a fixed radius
_type_notes.upstream_catchment: planned: traversal via next_down DAG with distance-decay weighting
_type_notes.polity_mean: planned: area-weighted mean over basins intersecting a polygon

neighborhood._basin_level_note: Only level 8 currently loaded. Level 6 pending.

data_sources.temporal_climate: LMR v2.1 (Tardif et al. 2019); coverage 0–1998 CE; 2°×2° grid, annual

location._note: id and zone/strata/land_cover fields are returned at top level in current API
location.land_cover_name: Sparse herbaceous or sparse shrub cover

toponym._status: planned — will carry WHG resolution metadata when place name provided

basins._status: planned — will carry hybas_id, sub_area_km2, up_area_km2, geom_geojson as structured sub-object
basins._note: geom_geojson currently returned as a top-level raw string key

A_physiographic._band_note: Stable over geological timescales; defensible as historical baseline for any period

derived._relief_note: relief_range = elev_max - elev_min; relief_position = (elev_point - elev_min) / relief_range

_planned_A: permafrost_pct (prm_pc_sse/use — currently misassigned to Band C)

B_hydroclimatic._band_note: Largely stable over centuries; discharge and runoff are delivered/integrated measures reflecting upstream catchment
B_hydroclimatic._note_pnv: pnv_majority and pnv_shares currently assigned to Band B; codebook and schema target Band C (vegetation)

C_bioclimatic._band_note: Contemporary WorldClim baseline. For period queries, Band F LMR values supersede or supplement these.
C_bioclimatic._temp_note: stored ×10 in basin08; divided by 10 in view
C_bioclimatic._aridity_note: P/PET moisture index; higher = wetter. Primary s/u divergence variable. Equal here because default basin is too small to capture Niger catchment — see scenario 00.
C_bioclimatic._permafrost_note: currently in Band C; codebook and schema target Band A (cryosphere)
C_bioclimatic.freshwater_ecoregion_class: Tropical and subtropical floodplain rivers and wetlands

D_anthropocene._band_note: Present-day only. Exclude for pre-modern analyses; use as contrast baseline.
_planned_D: soil_organic_carbon (note: codebook assigns to Band B soils)

E_coastality._band_note: Hydrological connectivity to marine outlet. Always present; endorheic flag changes interpretation of dist_sink.
E_coastality._dist_sink_note: flow distance in km to marine outlet via basin network; 0 in BasinATLAS for endorheic basins (not zero distance — no outlet)
E_coastality._coast_flag_note: true if basin directly touches coast

F_temporal._status: implemented — wired to /api/signature when bands includes F and from_year/to_year provided
F_temporal._band_note: Period-specific climate enrichment from LMR v2.1 and eVolv2k v4. Null / status message when period not requested or out of LMR range (0–1998 CE).

_out_of_range_response._note: LMR v2.1 coverage is 0–1998 CE. Requested period is outside this range. Bands A–E are unaffected.

_not_requested_response._note: Include from_year and to_year (CE integers) to retrieve Band F temporal data.

profile_summary._note: Ordered list of {key, label, value} for the top summary panel. Fields selected in signature.py PROFILE_SUMMARY.

profile_groups._note: Dict keyed A–F. Each value is {label, items: [{key, label, value}]}. label is currently the raw API key; friendly labels are the next UI task.

narrative._status: implemented via /api/narrative endpoint; not yet embedded in /api/signature response
narrative._note: LLM-generated natural language summary via Claude API. Triggered separately by the sandbox 'Generate' button.
